definitions.gloss: happosai; mixed stir-fry in a thick sauce
definitions.explanation: A Chinese-style dish of many ingredients (cabbage, carrots, mushrooms, pork, shrimp, quail eggs and so on) stir-fried and finished in a sauce thickened with starch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八宝菜|はっぽうさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
{八宝菜|はっぽうさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧にかけて{中華丼|ちゅうかどん}にした。
examples.english: I poured the happosai over rice to make a chukadon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{八宝菜|はっぽうさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Happosai is handy on busy days because you can use up all the vegetables left in the fridge.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From Chinese: {八|はっ} (eight, here "many") + {宝|ぽう} (treasure) + {菜|さい} (dish). The number is not literal; any good mix of ingredients will do.

USAGE:
A staple of Japanese home cooking and of {町中華|まちちゅうか}, the neighbourhood Chinese restaurant. Served over rice it becomes {中華丼|ちゅうかどん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {八宝菜|はっぽうさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make happosai
- {八宝菜|はっぽうさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{素|もと}→素：28734_moto⟧: ready-made happosai sauce mix
